Apk Repacker Revived has a file manager for your shared storage: it opens APKs from any folder, copies and edits files, and saves built APKs. Android only allows this with the "All files access" permission.

On the next screen, turn on "Allow access to manage all files" for this app, then come back.

Without it, your projects keep working, but the file manager and file pickers can't browse shared storage.
Storage permission is turned off for this app. You can turn it on in the app settings.
Without storage access the file manager can\'t browse shared storage. Your projects still work.
Could not open the permission settings. Please allow \"All files access\" for this app in system settings.
To install the APK, allow Apk Repacker Revived to install unknown apps on the next screen, then come back and tap Install again.
